info.name: Omni AI User model roles API

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user to retrieve model roles for.

params.name: modelId
params.description: Filter results to a specific model ID. If not provided, returns roles for all models the user has access to.

params.name: connectionId
params.description: Filter results to models from a specific connection. If not provided, returns roles for all connections.

items.docs: Retrieves the model role assignments for a user. This includes both direct role assignments and roles inherited from user group memberships.

info.name: Assign or update user model role

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user to assign or update a model role for.

items.docs:
Assigns or updates a model role for a user. If the user already has a role for the specified model, this endpoint will update it to the new role.

Model roles control what actions a user can perform on models and connections. To manage users, see the [User APIs](/api/users).
